- Develop a C# application that interacts with network devices/APIs and sends data to a Python script for ML analysis.
Utilize Docker for containerizing your project components.
resources: Kaggle datasets related to network security/traffic
Packet analysis libraries in Python (e.g., Scapy - for advanced users)
weeks.project_idea: A comprehensive project demonstrating skills across Networking, Data Analysis, and AI, using Docker for deployment.
